recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up source work is needed for FHIR-12956 unless a future work group decision changes SearchParameter.base semantics.
issue_request: FHIR-12956 was a Published FHIR-core SearchParameter clarification with Persuasive resolution. It asked to clarify the notions of resource, resource type, and type in SearchParameter.base by replacing wording about a search parameter having a type/resource with wording that it applies to at least one resource type and applies to more than one resource type when multiple bases are listed.
initial_application: The Jira comment cites svn revision 13370, represented in git by 20ea7a67dfd5d0083c9f1446c8d030c9ff6843dd. That commit changed source/searchparameter/searchparameter-spreadsheet.xml from the old have/type wording to the requested apply/resource-type wording, and later source rework preserved the clarification in source/searchparameter/structuredefinition-SearchParameter.xml.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists searchparameter=SearchParameter and marks SearchParameter approved, confirming current build scope. FHIR-12958 is a neighboring SearchParameter.type clarification already represented by a separate no-change audit commit. FHIR-37791 later added interface behavior to the same SearchParameter.base comment without reversing the FHIR-12956 wording. Community searches found no relevant Zulip or Confluence evidence that changes the Jira/source/history conclusion.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current source/searchparameter/structuredefinition-SearchParameter.xml already says a search parameter must apply to at least one resource type, says multi-base parameters apply to more than one resource type, and current source contains no remaining old have/type wording needing correction.

related_jiras.note: Clarified neighboring SearchParameter.type wording and was already represented on the combined branch by a separate audit commit.
Later added interface behavior to SearchParameter.base without reversing the FHIR-12956 apply/resource-type clarification.
